header.name: InvUI locked-click probe - DISPOSABLE TEST WORLD ONLY
header.description: DISPOSABLE TEST WORLD ONLY. Observes whether a normal click on an ItemLockMode.slot item in a VirtualContainer raises VirtualContainerItemChangeAfterEvent. Observation only: no JSON UI, no restore, no click handler. Items are minecraft:stick and minecraft:paper only. NOT saved; never store valuables. A taken item may stay locked in your inventory.
